purpose: Whole-project OSS stack for reconstructing, generating, editing and rendering hybrid 2D/3D environments for Blender and animation.
authority: Blender remains the canonical animation/scene assembly authority; Gaussian scenes are derivative environment representations.

projects.name: SkySplat Blender
projects.reason: addon declares external COLMAP and Brush dependencies; dependency licenses/binaries remain outside production authority until audited

pipeline: 2D plates, photos, video or procedural maps -> reconstruction/world-source manifest
camera poses + sparse geometry -> gsplat/OpenSplat reconstruction lane
Gaussian scene -> Blender environment handoff without mutating canonical character assets
all adopted outputs -> source hash, output hash, exact command, numerical QC and visual evidence
laws: Gaussian environment data is derivative and never canonical MARS geometry.
No opaque dependency or bundled binary becomes production-authoritative without license review.
No paid service is required for the production control plane.
